title: Position Words: On Top, Under, In Front, Behind and Next To
seo_title: Grade R Position Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade R: Position, orientation and views
standard_text: Describe the position of one object in relation to another (on top of, in front of, behind, left, right, up, down, next to); follow directions.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: position words on top of, under, above, below, in front of, behind and next to. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
key_sub: Above is higher; below is lower.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Position words tell us where things are.
  • On top of, under, above, below.
  • In front of, behind, next to, between.
  • Use your own body: stand in front of the chair, then behind it.

Examples

Example

The cat is on the bed. Where is the cat?

on top of the bed

Answer: on top of

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Above or belowAbove is higher.
In front or behindIn front is where you can see the face.
Next toNext to is beside, touching or close.

faq.a: The Reception Year, the year before Grade 1 and the first year of the Foundation Phase. Learners are about 5 to 6 years old.

faq.q: Which position words are in Grade R?
faq.a: On top of, under, above, below, in front of, behind, next to, between, up and down.

faq.q: Do learners use left and right?
faq.a: They start to, with their own body.
